security_justification.audit_integrity: Client claims are linked to audit records only as client_claim annotations and never overwrite server-owned fields, so the server's authoritative record is unchanged by anything a client says.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Client evidence is never authentication or authorization evidence; its trust is below every authenticated level and no mapping writes it to a decision field.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Every record carries the delegated decision_source and states that the owner has not personally reviewed it, so no delegated decision reads as a human owner decision.
security_justification.concurrency: The proposal introduces no runtime; later ingress validation is synchronous and single-use nonce checks are atomic with acceptance.
security_justification.confidentiality: The inventory excludes every value a fingerprint or identity could be built from, and the browser package holds no credential or secret.
security_justification.cryptography: Only Web Crypto randomness for identifiers is planned; no key, signature, or keyed transform is introduced, and Mode B attestation is deferred to its own decision.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Ingress rejections are counted by stable class without raw payloads or identifiers, and are never audit evidence.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external service is integrated; the browser package makes no network request and platform attestation is deferred to the Mode B decision.
security_justification.fail_posture: Unknown versions, unknown fields, oversized content, replayed nonces, and fabrication attempts are rejected, never repaired, and any #118 stop criterion ends the wave.
security_justification.lifecycle: Identifiers live for one interaction and are never persisted; the wave's task groups run strictly in order with authorization before implementation.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: This proposal adds only its own change directory; later groups own their exact paths through owned_paths updates.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No transformation of personal data is planned because the inventory contains none beyond a per-interaction random identifier and a closed-vocabulary kind.
security_justification.resource_retention: Envelopes have no retention of their own and are deleted whole with the audit record they annotate; the SDK retains nothing past one interaction.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: A replayed envelope is rejected by single-use nonce in Mode A, and retries of the host request carry the same interaction identifier without creating new claims.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The browser, host page, and network are attacker-controlled; the backend ingress is the boundary and admits only closed, bounded, client_claim envelopes.
